title: Episode 84 — Tara Singh Refuses the Turks

blocks.text: Episode 84 introduces Tara Singh as a figure of fearless constancy, the kind of Singh whose honour is carried openly and who will not bend merely to prolong life.

The conflict turns on pressure from hostile officials and neighbours, but Tara Singh refuses the logic behind dangai hî tc paiyug patishâhî and will not let khushâmad kar kar singhan ki Ievai mulak basâi become the price of survival.
The rough verse line sis dharc hath pur phirai nahi marnô sankai and the refrain aisi pari târc singh bana together present him as the type of Sikh who would rather risk death than flatter the state.
